facts.fact: StackAdapt reports that about 87% of B2B campaigns on its platform were awareness and engagement campaigns.
facts.quote: we found that about 87% of them were awareness and engagement campaigns, and under 13% had conversions as a primary goal.

facts.fact: StackAdapt reports that under 13% of B2B campaigns on its platform had conversions as a primary goal.
facts.quote: and under 13% had conversions as a primary goal.

facts.fact: StackAdapt reports that 81% of B2B campaigns run on its platform used native ads.
facts.quote: Our analysts found that of all B2B campaigns run in StackAdapt, 81% of them were native.

facts.fact: StackAdapt reports that 12% of its B2B campaigns used display ads.
facts.quote: Our users agree, with 12% of their B2B campaigns using display.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's media mix chart shows 7% of B2B campaigns used video.
facts.quote: Bar chart of media mix for B2B: 81% Native, 12% Display, 7% Video.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt analysis, videos 11-15 seconds long had a 79% completion rate compared with a 45% completion rate for 91-120 second videos.
facts.quote: We found that videos between 11-15s have a 79% completion rate compared to 91-120s videos, which had only a 45% completion rate.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states its 3rd-party audience catalogue features audiences from B2B data providers including Dun & Bradstreet and Bombora.
facts.quote: StackAdapt has a large 3rd-party audience catalogue, featuring audiences from B2B forward providers like Dun & Bradstreet and Bombora.

facts.fact: StackAdapt supports uploading first-party data through integrations with Adobe Audience Manager, Salesforce and LiveRamp.
facts.quote: with StackAdapt you can easily upload your 1st-party data through our integrations with Adobe Audience Manager, Salesforce and LiveRamp.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that ABM cookie pools can be built from D-U-N-S Lists, Target Account Lists, Domains and IPs.
facts.quote: ABM cookie pools can be built from[D-U-N-S Lists](https://www.dnb.com/ca-en/duns-number/lookup.html), Target Account Lists, Domain and IPs.

facts.fact: According to the page, Dun & Bradstreet ABM segments can expand targeting to include the full family tree of a target account.
facts.quote: Expansion to include the full family tree for your target accounts.

facts.fact: According to the page, Dun & Bradstreet ABM segments allow exclusions or restrictions on matched businesses so that impressions and media spend are not wasted.
facts.quote: Exclusions or restrictions to matched businesses ensure you are not wasting impressions and media spend.

facts.fact: According to the page, Dun & Bradstreet ABM segments offer professional overlays to reach professionals at a target business by seniority level or job function.
facts.quote: Professional overlays to reach professionals in certain seniority levels or job functions at your target business.

facts.fact: The page's chart description states that First Party data is the largest share of B2B audience targeting in every channel (Native, Display and Video).
facts.quote: Pie charts of targeting for B2B audiences across Native, Display and Video. First Party is the largest share in every channel.
